<!-- Release: v0.12.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; updates the existing `.debug` app in place. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Customize Library filters, their order, and All’s collections; hold a filter for the settings shortcut
- Sort songs and collections by Date added, Date modified, or Most played, with local listening counts starting in this version
- Preserve added dates across rescans and playlist attribution through saved queues; standardize Album Artist labels

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/43 - Configurable mixed collections and date/play-count sorting

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.12.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Install over your existing development app to keep its data.
